name: research_digest
description: Collects RSS/Atom feeds, public Telegram channel pages, and optional Last30Days reports into a deduplicated AI/ML/business research digest.
when_to_use: User wants to monitor AI, engineering, ML adoption, agentic systems, business implementation cases, research papers, or prepare a Telegram-channel news digest.

scheduled_tasks.name: daily_ai_research_digest
scheduled_tasks.description: At 14:00 Moscow time, prepare a weekly Telegram-ready digest with exactly 6 highest-scoring items using the research digest prepare_digest tool (hours=168, limit=6, min_score=1, refresh=true, limit_per_source=30). Return its final_response directly and mention source errors only if the tool reports them.

components.idle: Refresh configured RSS/Atom, public Telegram, and Last30Days sources.
